endorsements.name: Jeff
endorsements.label: KinectasploitV2: Kinect Meets 20 Security Tools
endorsements.description: Last year saw the release of Kinectasploit v1 linking the Kinect with Metasploit in a 3D, first person shooter environment. What if we expanded Kinectasploit to use 20 security tools in honor of DEF CON's 20th anniversary?!
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
